description: Source code for managing vendor modules in a hardware abstraction layer, including loading, unloading, initialization, and information retrieval of vendor modules, with dynamic shared object handling.

classes.name: wld_vendorModule_t
classes.description: Represents a vendor module with associated shared object, name, and hardware-agnostic flag.

methods.name: s_findVendorModule
methods.description: Finds a vendor module by name in the internal list.

methods.name: s_countVendorModules
methods.description: Counts vendor modules associated with a specific shared object.

methods.name: s_unloadVendorModule
methods.description: Unloads and cleans up a vendor module.

methods.name: s_loadVendorModule
methods.description: Loads and registers a vendor module from a shared object.

methods.name: s_execVendorModuleApi
methods.description: Executes a specified API function of a vendor module.

methods.name: s_initVendorModule
methods.description: Initializes a vendor module with provided info.

methods.name: s_getVendorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves vendor info from a module.

methods.name: s_deinitVendorModule
methods.description: Deinitializes a vendor module.

methods.name: s_loadSharedObj
methods.description: Loads all vendor modules from a shared object.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadInternal
methods.description: Loads internal vendor modules.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadExternal
methods.description: Loads vendor modules from an external shared object file.

methods.name: s_filterModNames
methods.description: Filters directory entries to identify vendor module shared object files.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadExternalDir
methods.description: Loads vendor modules from all shared object files in a directory.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_unloadAll
methods.description: Unloads all vendor modules.

methods.name: s_updateVendorModuleInfo
methods.description: Updates vendor module info, such as hardware-agnostic flag.

methods.name: s_getInfoAll
methods.description: Retrieves info for all vendor modules.

methods.name: s_initAll
methods.description: Initializes all vendor modules, prioritizing non-hardware-agnostic first.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_initAll
methods.description: Initializes all vendor modules with provided info.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_deinitAll
methods.description: Deinitializes all vendor modules.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadDefaultsAll
methods.description: Loads default settings for all vendor modules.
